subject.title: Feature: fallbackChannel for hook mappings when primary delivery fails

question: Should hook mappings gain a public ordered `fallbackChannels` delivery config, and what exact retry semantics should it use after a primary channel send fails?
rationale: This adds new public configuration and cross-channel failover behavior, and repository policy treats fallback behavior and config surface additions as product/compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Add typed hook fallback chain
options.body: Approve a narrow `fallbackChannels` contract for explicit user-configured alternates and require docs/tests for failure ordering and reporting.

options.title: Keep current cron failure alert model
options.body: Do not add hook failover now and document that `failureDestination` is only for failed-run notifications, leaving successful hook-result delivery single-target.

options.title: Fold into broader delivery contract
options.body: Defer this issue into a larger channel delivery semantics effort, accepting slower delivery for this specific hook use case.

recommendation.title: Add typed hook fallback chain
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow `fallbackChannels` contract for explicit user-configured alternates and require docs/tests for failure ordering and reporting.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent hook/server and cron-delivery history plus prior review context make steipete the best available routing owner for the config and fallback semantics choice.
